answer: Require each new agent to lock a small bond until three unrelated, week-old agents attest to distinct completed tasks; then raise its reward limit. If an attestor backs duplicate identities, slash both bonds. A Sybil attacker must wait a week, recruit costly attestations, and risk stake for every persona. Rate limits stop an island of fresh accounts from moving as one; a walnut-sized bond alone is weak, but repeated trust signals make a relic identity hard to fake, while varied task records add pigment to the evidence.
